text.en: Model soups is row 118 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Ensemble area.
text.zh: Model soups 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 118 行，所属领域为“集成学习”。

text.en: The annual table associates Model soups with “Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Model soups 与论文《Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Mitchell Wortsman, Yair Carmon, Simon Kornblith, Ludwig Schmidt”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Mitchell Wortsman（官方页拼写）、Yair Carmon（官方页拼写）、Simon Kornblith（官方页拼写）、Ludwig Schmidt（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Mitchell Wortsman, Yair Carmon, Simon Kornblith, Ludwig Schmidt”。
